name: face-swap-studio
description: Production-ready Face Swap Studio Suite - Web App and Windows 10 Desktop Application

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../desktop && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:backend: echo 'Backend is Node.js - no build needed'
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:frontend && cp -r frontend/build desktop/frontend-build && cd desktop && npm run build:win
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend

author: Face Swap Studio Team
